paragraphs.source_en: The great lantern inside Osaka Castle was a celebrated treasure in which Toyotomi Hideyoshi took great pride, famed throughout the realm. Thus, when Ieyasu said that he wished to take his retainers into the castle to see it, the guards hesitated; while they wavered, the party swiftly passed through the gate. This plainly violated the regulations and was outrageously audacious; the castle guards immediately reported it to the senior retainers attending Hideyori. In an instant, a murderous tension filled the inner castle.
